title: EN 16931 document totals, BR-CO-10 to BR-CO-17, as the CII Schematron checks them
constraints: has allowanceTotal and allowanceTotal = sum(allowances.amount) or no allowanceTotal and no allowances
has chargeTotal and chargeTotal = sum(charges.amount) or no chargeTotal and no charges
has vatTotal and totalWithVat = totalWithoutVat + vatTotal or totalWithVat = totalWithoutVat

vatBreakdown.rate < 0.5 and vatBreakdown.taxAmount >= -0.5 and vatBreakdown.taxAmount < 0.5 or vatBreakdown.rate >= 0.5 and vatBreakdown.rate * abs(vatBreakdown.taxableAmount) - 100 * abs(vatBreakdown.taxAmount) >= -100.5 and vatBreakdown.rate * abs(vatBreakdown.taxableAmount) - 100 * abs(vatBreakdown.taxAmount) < 100.5
